# Hempdustry 2

> Hempdustry 2 (formerly GanjaCraft) is a free, open-source cannabis mod for Minecraft Java Edition on Fabric and NeoForge (Minecraft 26.3, 1.21.11 and 1.21.1, all still updated; last builds for 26.2 and 26.1.2), on Fabric and Forge (Minecraft 1.20.1, last build) and on Forge (Minecraft 1.18.2 and 1.16.5, last builds). You grow weed (cannabis, marijuana, hemp) in fields, grow pots or hydro trays, smoke it in a spliff, pipe, bong or vaporizer, sift and press it into hash and rosin, cook edibles from cannabutter, and build with hempcrete, hemp bricks and hemp planks. It is designed as a Vanilla+ mod: everything is meant to feel like Mojang shipped it. Current version: 2.1.1, stable, released 13 November 2026 on 26.3, 26.2, 26.1.2, 1.21.11, 1.21.1 and 1.20.1 (2.1.0 came out in October 2026). Only 26.3, 1.21.11 and 1.21.1 keep getting updates; 26.2, 26.1.2 and 1.20.1 end with 2.1.1, and 1.18.2 and 1.16.5 with 2.1.0, whose builds stay available for converting old worlds. Made by Warlon Mhite.

## Facts

- Game: Minecraft Java Edition only. No Bedrock or Pocket Edition.
- Loaders: Fabric (needs Fabric API) and NeoForge (needs nothing else) since 2.1.0, and Forge (needs nothing else) on 1.20.1, 1.18.2 and 1.16.5. Install on client and server.
- Minecraft versions: 26.3, 26.2, 26.1.2, 1.21.11 and 1.21.1 on Fabric and NeoForge, 1.20.1 on Fabric and Forge, 1.18.2 and 1.16.5 on Forge; one download per loader and version, named `hempdustry-<loader>-2.1.1+<minecraft>.jar` (`2.1.0` on 1.18.2 and 1.16.5). The 1.21.1 and 1.20.1 builds lack the Hemp Shelf, the Hemp Harness and canvas bundles; 1.20.1 needs Java 17. The 26.x builds have a few extras (below) and need Java 25; 26.1.2 lacks the footbag, powdery mildew and jelly legs. The 1.18.2 build (Java 17) also lacks the hanging sign, the boat with chest, archaeology finds and outfit trims; the 1.16.5 build (Java 8) lacks those plus the tinted bong, lush caves and goats, and uses iron where newer versions use copper. No build for Bedrock or for the versions in between.
- Old worlds: the 1.16.5 Forge build opens every GanjaCraft 1.16.5 world (BETA v0.4 to v0.5.1, and 1.0.0 to 1.0.6) and converts it as it loads. The 1.18.2 Forge build opens Hemp-Craft worlds (all three of its builds) and GanjaCraft 1.16.5 worlds. Back up the world, remove the old mod's jar, add Hempdustry, open the world. The old GanjaCraft files still listed on the CurseForge page are a different mod.
- License: code AGPL-3.0, art and music CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Free, nothing paywalled. Allowed in modpacks, monetized ones included.
- Languages: 12 (English US/UK/CA/AU/NZ, French FR/CA/CH, German DE/AT/CH, Russian). Russian does not cover 2.1 yet.
- Optional: JEI and REI recipe pages on both loaders (REI on NeoForge needs 26.3 or 1.21.x; on 26.3 with Architectury API 22.0.5 or newer), EMI on 1.21.1 and 1.20.1 (REI on Forge 1.20.1 needs Architectury and Cloth Config), JEI 10 or REI 8 on 1.18.2, JEI on 1.16.5. Server owners can switch off every drug effect in config/hempdustry.json and keep only industrial hemp.
- Worlds from any Hempdustry 2 version open on every later one.
- Documentation: the wiki (41 pages) has the numbers: installation per version, grow times, effects, recipes, every config key, tags, datapacks, custom strains and the addon API.

## What's in 2.1.0

- Three strains: Purple Kush (2 blocks tall, jungles, swamps, lush caves), Lemon Haze (3 blocks tall, savanna to badlands) and Beldía (a Moroccan landrace from the Rif that grows on sand near water; wild on desert riverbanks). Shear plants to trim them. Bees pollinate, chickens and parrots eat seeds, goats eat leaves, creepers sometimes hide in grown fields.
- Indoor growing: Grow Pot (water bottle + bone meal, 1.5x a good field), Grow Lamp (two extra buds per plant), Hydro Tray (water, fertilizer and a redstone-powered pump, 2x the best field). Losing light or water while flowering stresses a plant; stressed plants lose buds and spoil some into schwag.
- Smoking: spliff, wooden pipe, bong (16 stained-glass colors plus tinted, can be set down, hold to draw) and Redstone Vaporizer (gentle, never greens you out). Purple Kush gives Resistance, Lemon Haze Speed and Haste, Beldía Invisibility, hash Night Vision, each with downsides and munchies. Over-smoking can green you out.
- Hash: Sifting Box (dry sift to kief, or an ice-water wash to bubble hash), Hemp Press (heated screw press: hashish, filtered hashish, rosin), charas rubbed off ripe plants, moon rocks, hash bars you cut with a sword. No BHO.
- Kitchen: Decarboxylator oven, cauldron rinse, Infuser, real cannabutter. Six edibles: space cookie, space brownie, space cake, cannabutter toast, dawamesk, bucket of bhang. Delayed onset like real edibles. Plus non-psychoactive hemp foods: toasted hemp seeds, hemp seed bar, hemp milk, siemieniotka.
- Building: hempcrete, hemp bricks, full fireproof hemp wood set (doors, fences, signs, boats, shelf), hemp parquet, canvas and hemp wool that replace leather and wool, Hemp Bed, Hemp Harness for the happy ghast, canvas bundles, a hemp leaf banner pattern. A dyeable hemp outfit that lasts like leather.
- Extras: 42 advancements, seven paintings, two original music discs by Nefuß, datapack-defined strains, datapack machine recipes, addon events on both loaders.

## Only on Minecraft 26.x

These use things Minecraft 26.1 and 26.2 added, so the 1.21.x builds do not have them. Both loaders. The 26.1.2 build has the 4:20 time marker, The Munchies, the baby outfit sizes and other mods' farmland, but not the footbag, mildew or jelly legs, which need 26.2.

- Footbag: feed a hemp bale to a large sulfur cube; it stops bouncing, floats, and a punch pops it up about two blocks.
- Powdery mildew: hemp under a roof (glass included) can catch it and pass it to neighbours; a quarter of a mildewed plant's buds become schwag. Shears clear it in a trim window; potent sulfur under water gives a gas that keeps it off, but gassing a flowering plant spoils a tenth of its buds. Fields never get it. `world.mildew` in the config turns it off.
- Jelly legs: a green-out makes your feet slide and hits knock you further, while it lasts.
- `/time set hempdustry:four_twenty` puts the Overworld at 4:20 pm.
- The Munchies: a 43rd advancement, eat while under Hunger and too hungry to sprint.
- The hemp outfit in baby sizes on baby zombies, husks, drowned, zombie villagers and piglins.
- Hemp grows on any soil another mod adds to Minecraft's crop tags.
- On NeoForge 26.2 the footbag gets about half the kick and jelly legs only slide; on 26.3 NeoForge matches Fabric.

## Coming later (ideas, no dates)

Warped Kush and Crimson (Nether strains), Ruderalis, Industrial Hemp and Ditchweed. Someday: custom High and Munchies effects with tolerance, a hemprepreneur villager, a pillager dealer's hideout.
